latest_release.name: v1.20261113.1
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* TS URLPattern implementation by @jasnell in https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/pull/8270
* Add util.diff to node:util by @littledivy in https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/pull/8332
* Document that a canceled JSRPC call doesn't stop a Durable Object by @danlapid in https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/pull/8381
* Move worker-loader-test's Python cases into their own test by @danlapid in https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/pull/8376
* Tag wpt wasm/jsapi cpu:2 by @danlapid in https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/pull/8377
* Don't sleep in unsafe-module-test's alarm deletion case by @danlapid in https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/pull/8378
* Require `Traced` trait implementors to be `Send` by @nathanwhit in https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/pull/8355
* Speed up kv-test's streamedPut and remove blobGc's sleeps by @danlapid in https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/pull/8373
* Don't sync Durable Object storage in workerd test by @danlapid in https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/pull/8375
* rust jsg: read array elements without a TracedGlobal each by @nathanwhit in https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/pull/8323
* Add canBeForwarded to ForwardableEmailMessage types by @cjol in https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/pull/8371
* Port MemoryCache to Rust, behind an autogate by @bartlomieju in https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/pull/8066
* Don't eagerly load stdio if process is mentioned by @erikcorry in https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/pull/8265
* Rust JSG: iterable resources and intrinsic inheritance by @bartlomieju in https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/pull/8264
* Improve management of bundled sources by @erikcorry in https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/pull/8387
* Fix node:crypto diffieHellman with an imported public key by @littledivy in https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/pull/8393
* Add mock.property to node:test by @littledivy in https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/pull/8383
* Allow setAuthTag() after update() for GCM Decipheriv by @littledivy in https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/pull/8392
* Implement path.matchesGlob by @littledivy in https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/pull/8390
* Implement KeyObject.toCryptoKey by @littledivy in https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/pull/8384
* Add jsg::Lock::exception_to_kj() to Rust JSG by @bartlomieju in https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/pull/8338
* Implement the node:console Console constructor by @littledivy in https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/pull/8359
* Add jsg-js-reentry clang-tidy check by @littledivy in https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/pull/8280
* Include Node.js' license in the node:console Console sources by @littledivy in https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/pull/8399
* Say where await_io_and_run() first polls its future by @littledivy in https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/pull/8398
* Give the encoding and compression stream benches a longer CI timeout by @littledivy in https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/pull/8407
* Fail cross-request awaits of promises that can no longer settle by @danlapid in https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/pull/8395
* Add kvData to Durable Object snapshot restores by @maxmcd in https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/pull/8098
* Remove the streams try sync autogate by @jasnell in https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/pull/8366

## New Contributors
* @cjol made their first contribution in https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/pull/8371

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/compare/v1.20261112.1...v1.20261113.1
